about: How much disk OpenBot Desktop needs and uses, as the window says it, in GB of 2^30 bytes. The window reads it (Welcome.tsx, localReadiness.ts), the Rust tests hold local_eval.rs and early_downloads.rs to it, and scripts/disk-needs.ts checks every release's images against it and fails when a number stops being true. Measured on 2026-11-19 with v1.1.0 and its back end, Intelligence 0.16.0-rc.13: 7.5 GB installed, up to 4.5 GB more while an update downloads beside the running release, logs under 1.3 GB, and images taking onDisk times their download.
